name: Aberrant Polycrase
description:
Aberrant molecules of Polycrase mineral that have been altered by exposure to hyperdimensional forces. The Caldari State needs this aberrant material to develop civilian shielding from Conquest Engine activations. 

The State will reward anyone who accepts their campaign objective and delivers this to their item trader outside the Caldari Navy Anchorage in <url=showinfo:5//30045324>Onnamon</url>.
